edge_reliability.meaning: share of a predicted edge (implied return over the engine market) that showed up as excess return over the universe in a typical year; allocation multiplies edges by the median, clipped to 0..1

caveats: survivorship: the universe is today's large caps; every stock portfolio and especially cheapness tilts are flattered (companies that looked cheap and then failed are absent); compare the engine with the earnings- and FCF-yield controls, which share the bias
today's SIC codes and listing labels; engine rules written in 2026 (in-sample design)
one formation a year: t-statistics below about 2 are noise
no consensus history: the forecast uses reported history only, as in an automatic run
